tools.name: find_games
tools.description: The games Wilderack hosts, or the ones matching a name: whether each is for sale now, starting soon or coming soon, its editions, mods, crossplay and the plan Wilderack suggests. No account needed. Use it first when someone asks where to host a game server.

tools.name: get_game
tools.description: One game in detail: its editions and server types (vanilla, plugins, mods, modpacks), how many players each plan suits, how players join, whether it sleeps when empty, crossplay, mod sources, publisher terms and its settings. No account needed.

tools.name: get_prices
tools.description: Wilderack's plans with their real prices for each period, the first-order offer and what they renew at. Every plan runs any game whose minimum fits. No account needed.

tools.name: list_regions
tools.description: Wilderack's regions, whether each takes new servers now, and the games that can start there. No account needed.

tools.name: plan_server
tools.description: Picks the edition, server type, plan and region for a game from what the person wants (how many players, mods or not), with the real price, and makes a checkout link on app.wilderack.com. The person opens the link, signs in or makes an account, checks everything and pays there; the server starts onc
